__inputs.name: PLATFORM_OPS
__inputs.label: 平台 /ops 完整 HTTPS 地址

title: 运行观测 · 执行影响

panels.title: 所选时段执行影响
panels.description: 按受理时间统计提交，按终态观测时间统计结果。失败率分母为成功加失败。

targets.rawSql: SELECT submissions AS "受理", failed AS "失败", completed AS "成功", cancelled AS "取消", unknown_now AS "期内受理且当前待核实", terminal_time_missing AS "期内受理但缺终态时间", failed_users AS "失败用户", failed_applications AS "失败应用", round(100.0 * failed / nullif(completed + failed, 0), 2) AS "失败率 (%)", statement_timestamp() AS "查询时间" FROM platform_ops_dashboard.execution_impact($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 'total')

panels.title: 受理、失败与取消 · 每五分钟
panels.description: 缩放时间轴可查看对应区间和 Agent 排行。

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, submissions AS "受理", failed AS "失败", cancelled AS "取消" FROM platform_ops_dashboard.execution_impact($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 'trend') ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: 执行失败率 · 每五分钟
panels.description: 成功与失败合计为零时比例未知。

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, 100.0 * failed / nullif(completed + failed, 0) AS "失败率 (%)" FROM platform_ops_dashboard.execution_impact($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 'trend') ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: 受失败影响的 Agent
panels.description: 点击列头切换排序，点击 Agent 进入对应平台时段。

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent AS "Agent", failed_users AS "失败用户", failed_applications AS "失败应用", failed AS "失败执行" FROM platform_ops_dashboard.execution_impact($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 'agent') WHERE failed > 0 ORDER BY failed_users DESC, failed DESC, agent

panels.title: 故障时段的失败会话
panels.description: 按最近一次失败列出最多 100 个会话。可缩短窗口；点击会话进入平台授权详情。

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent AS "Agent", session_id AS "会话", failures AS "失败执行", latest AS "最近失败" FROM platform_ops_dashboard.failed_sessions($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) ORDER BY latest DESC, agent, session_id

panels.title: 首段正文 · 服务端持久事件
panels.description: 等待从平台受理开始，服务端观测止于第一段非空持久正文。当前等待包括窗口前受理的活动执行。样本数与受理数按所选窗口核对；取消按确认时间统计。

targets.rawSql: SELECT channel AS "渠道", waiting_users AS "当前等待用户", round(longest_wait_seconds::numeric,1) AS "当前最长等待 (s)", queued_executions AS "已记录排队的执行", accepted AS "窗口受理", replied AS "首正文样本", accepted-replied AS "窗口内未观察到首正文", round(median_first_output_seconds::numeric,1) AS "首正文中位数 (s)", cancelled_before_output AS "首正文前取消", round(median_cancel_wait_seconds::numeric,1) AS "取消等待中位数 (s)", CASE channel WHEN 'Web' THEN '浏览器展示时间未知' WHEN '企微' THEN '首段送达时间未知' WHEN 'API' THEN '客户端接收时间未知' ELSE '未确认' END AS "渠道回执覆盖", '展示回执未知' AS "排队与加载提示", latest_first_output_at AS "最近首正文样本时间", statement_timestamp() AS "查询更新时间" FROM platform_ops_dashboard.reply_observations($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 'summary') ORDER BY channel

panels.title: 服务端首正文与回复前取消等待 · 五分钟中位数
panels.description: 首正文按受理时刻分桶，取消按确认时刻分桶。缺少对应样本的区间留空。

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, channel, median_first_output_seconds AS "首正文", median_cancel_wait_seconds AS "回复前取消" FROM platform_ops_dashboard.reply_observations($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 'trend') ORDER BY bucket, channel
